lines.text: Wives are to submit to their husbands, so unbelieving husbands may be won over without words by their pure and reverent demeanor.
True beauty comes not from braided hair, gold jewelry or fine clothes, but from the heart's gentle and quiet spirit.
The holy women of the past put their hope in angels, and Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord.
Husbands are to treat their wives with consideration and honor them as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life.
Whoever would love life must keep his hands from evil, turn from evil and do good, and seek peace.
